note: Texas County MO (29215): no public queryable county-wide parcel service found. County GIS viewer (texasgis.breezemaps.com, ClearBasin) shows no public ArcGIS REST endpoint; the official portal texasgis.countyportal.net requires a 160 dollar/yr subscription; assessor site points only to that subscription portal. Only ArcGIS parcel layer found is City of Mountain Grove parcels (city-only, not the county, not around the validation point). Regrid nationwide tiles service exposes no query endpoint (404); Apex_Missouri_Parcels covers pipeline counties, not Texas County.
